title: Smarter claims review
subtitle: XACTA | Claims intelligence
narration: Bring claim information, validation checks, and assisted review into one workspace. Xacta helps your team find questions worth reviewing before submission.

title: One claim. A clearer picture.
subtitle: Connected workflow
narration: Review diagnoses, procedures, supporting information, attachments, and payer responses. Save your changes, then launch the assistant from the claim.

title: Check completeness first
subtitle: Rules-based validation
narration: Check episode information, admission and discharge dates, and applicable newborn and ventilation fields. Review attachment requirements and follow the findings back to the relevant fields.

title: Turn error codes into actions
subtitle: NPHIES error guidance
narration: The assistant explains documented NPHIES errors and helps reviewers identify the next check. When an error has no documented explanation, it says so rather than inventing an answer.

title: Clinical documentation review
subtitle: Experimental | English notes
narration: Local medical entity extraction highlights terms in saved English notes. The review compares them with diagnosis descriptions and shows the original source text for human assessment.

title: Evidence before assumptions
subtitle: Human review stays in control
narration: A mention is not a diagnosis. Basic context checks flag phrases involving negation, uncertainty, and history. Text differences are review questions, never automatic coding instructions.

title: Prepared for the next connection
subtitle: Grouper integration readiness
narration: Export saved episode inputs to prepare for an approved grouper integration. Automatic Saudi DRG assignment is not connected. The assistant does not replace a certified grouper.

title: Clearer evidence. Better review.
subtitle: Explore XACTA
narration: Open a claim, save the information, and select the review mode. Use guided explanations or experimental local documentation review. Every final coding and submission decision remains with your team.
